claim: '印度古典逻辑最伟大的两个名字'定为佛教 Yogācāra school 论师陈那（六世纪）与法称（七世纪早期）。
locator: SEP Epistemology-india：'The two greatest names for classical Indian logic belong to logicians of the Buddhist Yogācāra school, Dignāga (sixth century) and Dharmakīrti (early seventh century).'
note: 2026-10-04 本任务独立 curl 抓取全文逐字核读（未复用 T01/I01/B03/I03 缓存）。陈那年代另有 S2 c. 480—c. 540 与 S3 'c. 5th – 6th century' 口径，三说并陈。

claim: 该学派在梵文中实际无名称；藏语称'随理者'；pramāṇavāda 为'方便的梵文误名'/'认识论学派'。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'He, and his predecessor Dignāga (c. 480–c. 540 C.E.), were responsible for a school of Buddhist thought that actually had no name in Sanskrit, although in Tibetan it was known as "those who follow reasoning" (rigs pa rjes su 'brang ba); in modern literature it is sometimes known by the convenient Sanskrit misnomer pramāṇavāda, or more simply, "the Epistemological School."'
note: 本包命名史核心证据；proposal.kindNote 引用。

claim: 该学派在泛印度论辩中代表佛教、对西藏影响巨大；汉地影响有限（法称无一部汉译）。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'it is the Buddhist school that provoked the most sophisticated and most important philosophical debates with non-Buddhist rivals. It represented Buddhism in the pan-Indian debates on problems of universals, philosophies of logic and language, and issues of justification, and had an enormous influence on Mahāyāna Buddhism in Central Asia, especially in Tibet.'；'although its influence was relatively limited in medieval China (only a few of the works of Dignāga were translated into Chinese, none of the works of Dharmakīrti were translated)'

claim: 陈那整合其师世亲的推理学说，为'印度逻辑史上的枢纽人物'；其三部逻辑著作存世形态（正理门汉译+西藏梵本未刊、因轮与集量论仅藏译）。
locator: SEP Logic-india：'The Buddhist thinker, Dignāga (c. 5th – 6th century ce), consolidates the insights into the canonical deductively valid syllogism of his predecessors, and in particular those of his teacher, Vasubandhu ... He is, in fact, a pivotal figure in the history of Indian logic.'；'Dignāga wrote three works pertaining to reasoning and argument. Unfortunately, in each case, the original Sanskrit text is not available. One, the Nyāya-mukha ... is extant in Chinese translation. However, a Sanskrit manuscript is now known to exist in Tibet. It has yet to be edited and published. The remaining two are extant only in Tibetan translation: Hetu-cakra-ḍamaru ... and his magnum opus, Pramāṇa-samuccaya ..., four of whose six chapters are devoted to inference or argument.'
note: 站内 philosophers.json 世亲条目 era'约公元4世纪至5世纪'与 S2'五世纪'口径相容（python 实查）。
uncertainty: 世亲与陈那的师承关系为 SEP 所记，无独立史料；站内世亲条目只说'论证形式为后世陈那、法称所继承'（弱化表述），relation 已标'师承（来源所记）'。

claim: 唯二量：譬喻量等被摄归现量比量；教科书总颂'能立與能破……及似唯自悟'。
locator: 维基文库《因明入正理論》开篇逐字：'　　能立與能破　　及似唯悟他　　現量與比量　　及似唯自悟　　如是總攝諸論要義。'；《因明正理門論》逐字：'爲自開悟唯有現量及與比量。彼聲喻等攝在此中故唯二量由此能了自共相故。非離此二別有所量爲了知彼更立余量。'
note: 两汉译各自独立核读，互证唯二量立场；S6 书目行'商羯羅主菩薩造唐三藏法師玄奘譯'逐字命中。

claim: 现量定义=离分别；比量定义=藉三相观义；量果即智。
locator: 维基文库《因明入正理論》逐字：'此中。現量謂無分別。若有正智於色等義離名種等所有分別。現現別轉。故名現量。言比量者。謂藉眾相而觀於義。相有三種。如前已說。由彼爲因。於所比義有正智生。了知有火或無常等。是名比量。於二量中即智名果。是證相故。如有作用而顯現故。亦名爲量。'

claim: 量-果同一的 Yogācāra 立场：源与果无别，排除'碰巧为真'的信念成为知识。
locator: SEP Epistemology-india：'Yogācāra Buddhists—who subscribe to the metaphysical view known as momentariness, which is a presentism (only things existing right now are real)—claim that there is no difference between source and result, process of knowledge and effect, pramāṇa and pramā. Thus there can be no wedge driven between cause and effect such that there could possibly be true belief by accident.'
note: pramāṇa 定义句同段：'The central notion throughout classical Indian epistemology is the "knowledge source," pramāṇa, which is a process of veridical-cognition generation.'

claim: 龙树《回诤论》第33颂的认证无穷倒退追问；弥曼差/吠檀多以 svataḥ prāmāṇya 回应；正理持外在认证（parataḥ prāmāṇya）。
locator: SEP Epistemology-india：'Nāgārjuna identifies a problem of a justification regress in the pramāṇa program (Vigraha-vyavārtinī, v. 33)'；'Mīmāṃsā and Vedānta philosophers argue that such a threat of regress shows that knowledge is self-certifying, svataḥ prāmāṇya.'；'Nyāya takes an extrinsicality view of certification (parataḥ prāmāṇya)—it denies that Kp entails KKp; to know that you know requires apperceptive certification'
note: 仅作 overview 背景一句；龙树由 T01/B02 承载，弥曼差正面体系由 I03 承载。

claim: 法称的量定义（PV II.1 可靠认知）、arthakriyāsthiti 认证、现量与推论'内在自为量'。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'Dharmakīrti, who defines a "source of knowledge" in Pramāṇavārttika II.1 as a "reliable (avisaṃvādin) cognition (jñāna)"'；'We can justifiably affirm that a cognition is correct if we can "confirm causal efficacy" (arthakriyāsthiti)'；'These are said to be "intrinsically sources of knowledge" (svataḥ prāmāṇya) and are prima facie reliable in that they will be trusted as knowledge unless it is shown that some cause of error is present.'
note: svataḥ prāmāṇya 的佛教版本与弥曼差版本（S1）同名异构，overview 与 cihai 均按两源并陈。

claim: 因三相教科书定义与标本例；同品/异品定义。
locator: 维基文库《因明入正理論》逐字：'因有三相。何等爲三。謂遍是宗法性。同品定有性。異品遍無性。'；'謂所立法均等義品。說名同品。如立無常瓶等無常。'；'異品者。謂於是處無其所立。若有是常見非所作。如虛空等。'；'此中所作性或勤勇無間所發性遍是宗法性。同品定有性。異品遍無性。是無常等因。'

claim: 陈那 trairūpya 三条检验（认知主体所知版本）。
locator: SEP Epistemology-india：'Dignāga formulates a threefold test for a good prover, trairūpya-hetu: the prover's occurrence on the inferential subject of a proposed inference must be known to the subject S; the prover's occurrence at least once together with the probandum must be known to S; no counter-case of a prover occurring without the probandum must be known to S.'

claim: 法称以来的因三相表述（pakṣadharmatva/anvayavyāpti/vyatirekavyāpti）与 niścita、jijñāsā 要求。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'pakṣadharmatva (the logical reason's being a property of the subject): the subject A is ascertained (niścita) as having the property C; anvayavyāpti (pervasion [that is formulated] as co-presence): C is ascertained as present in only instances that are similar (sapakṣa) to A insofar as they possess B; vyatirekavyāpti (pervasion [formulated] as co-absence): C is ascertained as wholly absent from instances dissimilar (vipakṣa) to A insofar as they do not possess B.'；'the opponent have the appropriate "desire to know" (jijñāsā)'

claim: 九句因/因轮：三乘三矩阵；陈那认定中列上下两格为善式；汉译总颂与'唯有二種名因'判定。
locator: SEP Logic-india：'what he called the wheel of reasons (hetu-cakra), an equivalent alternative to the three forms of reason (tri-rūpa-hetu). It comprises a three by three matrix ... Dignāga identified the syllogisms corresponding to the top and bottom cases of the middle column as good syllogisms'；维基文库《因明正理門論》逐字：'　　於同有及二　　在異無是因　　翻此名相違　　所餘皆不定'；'此中唯有二種名因。謂於同品一切遍有異品遍無。及於同品通有非有。異品遍無。'
note: 英文（矩阵描述）与汉译（颂文）分别独立核读。

claim: 法称三类因：自性因/果性因/不可得因（含三例句）；对应 tādātmya 与 tadutpatti 两种遍充根据。
locator: SEP Epistemology-india：'Dharmakīrti divides inferences into three kinds: sva-bhāva (self-nature: "It's a tree because it's a śiṃśapā oak") tad-utpatti (causality: "Fire is there because smoke is there") anupalabdhi (non-perception: "There is no pot here because none is perceived").'；SEP Logic-india：'the truth of the first premiss is guaranteed by either of two relations obtaining between properties: the causation relation (tadutpatti) and the identity relation (tādātmya).'

claim: 他比量两支式与结论不陈说；《诤理论》把说出结论定为败点（nigrahasthāna）；《正理門論》对应颂与散文。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'a two-membered form, known as an "inference-for-others" (parārthānumāna): All C's are B's, like D. / A is C.'；'stating the conclusion is actually a "point of defeat" (nigrahasthāna)'；'the only function of an inference-for-others is to show "provers" (sādhana), and a conclusion cannot prove itself.'；维基文库《因明正理門論》逐字：'　　如自決定已　　悕他決定生　　說宗法相應　　所立余遠離'；'爲於所比顯宗法性故說因言。爲顯於此不相離性故說喻言。爲顯所比故說宗言。於所比中除此更無其餘支分。'

claim: apoha 与不可言说：殊胜个体唯现量所及；PV I.61；《分析共相》引文；义总/声总之分。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'At the heart of Dignāga's and Dharmakīrti's philosophies is the principle that particulars, i.e., what is real, are only properly grasped by perception; the way they are in themselves is thus said to be "ineffable" (avyapadeśya; Tib. bstan bya min), "not an object of words" (śabdasyāviṣaya).'；PV I.61：'In all cases words expressing substances and their properties just make this [conceptual] distinction. Thus there is no difference whatsoever in the [object] to which they refer.'；'As Dignāga had put it in his Sāmānyaparīkṣā ("Analysis of Universals"): A word talks about entities only as they are qualified by the negation of other things.'；'non-non-blue is the universal-qua-object (arthasāmānya) signified by the term "blue", and non-non-"blue" is the universal-qua-word (śabdasāmānya)'

claim: 法称的因果化 apoha 改写：'这种对因果性的依赖在陈那那里似乎完全没有'；指称的因果理论。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'Causal chains and error are what serve to bridge the scheme-content gap, rather than the descriptive content of the apoha. It is notable that such reliance on causality seems to be entirely absent in Dignāga: it is Dharmakīrti's major contribution to the theory.'；'The way words link to things is thus primarily explained through the existence of a causal chain from particular things to perceptions to thoughts and to the utterances of words—in short we have a type of causal theory of reference.'

claim: Uddyotakara 对因三相的批评与法称的 eva 重述（NB 2.5）；eva 歧义为学界论题；'正理哲学家几乎把一切都归功于其佛教论敌'。
locator: SEP Logic-india：'Dignāga's formulation of the three forms came in for criticism at the hands of the Nyāya thinker, Uddyotakara (c. late 6th century ce), which was, in turn, addressed by Dharmakīrti, who uses the particle to express each of the three conditions (NB 2.5).'；'There is, however, no philological justification for such a translation.'（驳 necessary 译法，Gillon 1999）；SEP Epistemology-india：'The Nyāya philosopher owes almost everything to his Buddhist adversaries, as opposed to his Nyāya predecessors'

claim: 不可得因之争：法称主张缺席由比量知；Bhāṭṭa 弥曼差以 anupalabdhi 为独立知识来源、'感知只呈现存在物'。
locator: SEP Epistemology-india：'Dharmakīrti would answer, "By inference," inferential knowledge of an absence being one of three fundamental types identified by the Yogācārin'；'Bhāṭṭa Mīmāṃsā says no, there is operative here a special knowledge source called "non-cognition" or "non-perception," anupalabdhi. ... The Bhāṭṭa argues, for example, that perception makes known only presences.'
note: Bhāṭṭa 体系正面由 I03 承载，本包只写交锋侧。

claim: 刹那性两论证：vināśitvānumāna 承自世亲一系（被评为晦涩且缺乏说服力）；sattvānumāna 为法称自创（起于《量决定论》第二章）。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'one quite obscure and unconvincing, which he inherited from previous writers like Vasubandhu (fifth century C.E.)'；'This argument is known as "the inference [of things' momentariness] from the [mere] fact of [them] existing" (sattvānumāna), and seems to be largely Dharmakīrti's own invention, first developed in the second chapter of his Pramāṇaviniścaya.'

claim: svasaṃvedana：法称'一切觉知皆是反思性觉知'；'绝非对自我及其状态的了知'；两大主题（境相俱知；自照为记忆条件）。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'Dharmakīrti's idea of all awareness being "reflexive awareness" (svasaṃvedana) shows his internalism. But "reflexive awareness"—often termed "self-awareness" (even though for Buddhists it is emphatically not an awareness of a self and its states)'；'(1) that the mind perceives such and such objects as well as how it experiences those objects ...; (2) that reflexive awareness is a condition of sentience: an experience is not just a material process ... but can lead to subsequent memory and conceptualization because it is non-conceptually "auto-illuminated."'
note: 与 B03 的分工：B03 写唯识四分说谱系中的陈那三分；本包写量论认识论机制面。
uncertainty: 是否导向认识论内在主义为开放争论（Williams 1998/Kellner 2010/Arnold 2010，S2 记为'seem to be'两主题的重构）。

claim: '諸自證分'汉译原典层：义净译本把自证分归入现量外延。
locator: 维基文库《因明正理門論》逐字：'論曰。意地亦有離諸分別唯證行轉。又於貪等諸自證分。諸修定者離教分別。皆是現量。'；'若於貪等諸自證分亦是現量。何故此中除分別智。不遮此中自證現量。無分別故。'
note: '自證分'三字在汉译中逐字出现（与 B03 evidenceLimits 所记'汉字定名未在核读来源逐字出现'不同，此处有原典支持）。

claim: 汉地传播有限：法称无一部汉译；现代日本佛教学中法称研究供给认识论。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'none of the works of Dharmakīrti were translated'；'become increasingly important in modern Japan in supplying the epistemology for Buddhist thought.'

claim: 藏传课程：宗喀巴深受由陈那与法称创立的印藏量论传统影响；其时代课程含 pramāṇa；早年两大传统（桑普/萨迦）；1380纳塘辩四学科。
locator: SEP Tsongkhapa：'He is strongly influenced by the Indo-Tibetan Buddhist logico-epistemological tradition (pramāṇa; tshad ma), founded by the Indian epistemologists Dignāga and Dharmakīrti (fifth to seventh century).'；'a traditional Buddhist curriculum of abhidharma, tenet systems (Grub mtha') focusing on the Middle Way and Mind Only ... Buddhist ethics (sdom gsum), and epistemology (pramāṇa)'；'the Sangphu (gSang phu ne'u tog) tradition founded by Ngok Lotsawa Loden Sherab (rNgog bLo ldan shes rab, 1059–1109), and the Sakya (Sa skya) epistemological tradition based primarily on the works of the Sa skya paṇḍi ta (1182–1251).'；'After having successfully passed these philosophical debates at Narthang Monastery in 1380, he was from then on considered a master of the four primary disciplines of Buddhist scholarship'
note: 站内萨迦班智达 era'1182–1251'与 S4 一致（python 实查）。
uncertainty: '《释量论》在格鲁课程中的教科书地位'细节未核读，不写。

claim: 藏地诠释分歧：格鲁'理由未决定的真推测' vs 萨迦'与实相符的疑'；两派均否认其为量。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'If, however, one rightly thinks P is the case, but did "not [first] ascertain with a pramāṇa" (tshad mas ma nges pa) the characteristics of Q, R, this is deemed to be, in Geluk (dge lugs) texts, a "true presumption where the [character of the] reason was not determined" (Tib. rgyu mtshan gtan la ma phab pa'i yid dpyod), or following the Sakya (sa skya) thinkers, a mere "doubt that is in accord with the real" (Tib. the tshom don mthun). For both these Tibetan schools, such an understanding of P is not itself a pramāṇa.'
note: 本包藏传'诠释分歧线'的核心证据。

claim: 学派归属层次差：S1 归 Yogācāra school，S2 称无梵文名的'认识论学派'；两表述并陈不裁决。
locator: S1 'logicians of the Buddhist Yogācāra school'；S2 'a school of Buddhist thought that actually had no name in Sanskrit ... "the Epistemological School"'（两条 locator 见 /school/overview 第1、2条）
note: scopeAndCautions'不能把全部佛教认识论都归为唯识的单一分支'的对应处理。
uncertainty: 经量部关联未核读不写。

claim: 法称定年之争未决（6 vs 7世纪）；Frauwallner 论证被评为'近乎默证、离定论尚远'。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'It is still debated in the modern community of researchers on Dharmakīrti whether one should place this philosopher in the seventh century C.E. or in the sixth.'；'Erich Frauwallner came out strongly for 600–660 C.E. as Dharmakīrti's dates, using an argumentum ex silentio that is short of conclusive'；'Krasser (2012) relies heavily on connections between Dharmakīrti, Bhāviveka and Kumārila to push the dates of Dharmakīrti's activity back to the mid sixth century C.E.'；'Balcerowicz (2016) argues ... 550–610 as the dates for Dharmakīrti.'
note: Krasser/Balcerowicz 方案均依赖与清辨、鸠摩利罗、Samantabhadra 的联系定年，非直接史料。
uncertainty: 无定年。

claim: 法称生平圣传性质、坚实数据极少；生于南印度、后至那烂陀为藏地史料所记。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'The life of Dharmakīrti ... is a subject of hagiography with little solid data upon which we can confidently rely. If we go by Tibetan sources, he seems to have been born in South India and then to have moved to the great monastic university of Nālandā'
uncertainty: 生平细节均为圣传。

claim: 法称七部著作与 Frauwallner 定序；《释量论》为对集量论的未完成注释、对帝释慧已佚注的反应、niścaya 强调。
locator: SEP Dharmakīrti：'Frauwallner (1954) did most likely pin down the order in which Dharmakīrti composed five of his seven works, namely, and in this order, the Pramāṇavārttika, Pramāṇaviniścaya ... Nyāyabindu ... Hetubindu ..., and Vādanyāya ... The two minor works, the Sambandhaparīkṣā ... and Saṃtānāntarasiddhi ... are more difficult to place in the sequence.'；'It is an unfinished, highly philosophical, commentary on the Pramāṇasamuccaya ... of Dignāga. At various key places in the text we see that Dharmakīrti seems to have formulated some basic ideas as a reaction to now lost commentaries by Dignāga's students, the most important being the commentary on the Pramāṇasamuccaya by Īśvarasena. A notable reaction to Īśvarasena is Dharmakīrti's emphasis on certainty (niścaya).'
note: 'proto-text' 假说被评为 still speculative（S2 原文）。

claim: 帝释慧最早意识到普遍前提认证问题、以不可得奠基；法称论证其不充分。
locator: SEP Logic-india：'The earliest classical Indian philosopher thought to have recognized the problem of how one comes to know the truth of a universal statement seems to have been Īśvarasena (Steinkellner 1997 p. 638). He appears to have thought that knowledge of the major premiss is grounded in non-perception (anupalabdhi).'；'However, this suggestion does not solve the problem, for reasons laid out in detail by Dharmakīrti'
note: 帝释慧不入 thinkers（材料仅此两级），relation/陈那→法称 detail 已承载。
uncertainty: 'appears to have thought'为推断表述。

claim: 文本存世形态：集量论/因轮仅藏译、正理门汉译+西藏梵本未刊；本包两部汉译为教科书层与义净译本层而非陈那梵本原貌。
locator: SEP Logic-india（见 /school/overview 第4条 locator：'in each case, the original Sanskrit text is not available ... extant in Chinese translation ... a Sanskrit manuscript is now known to exist in Tibet. It has yet to be edited and published.'）
